newsitem.title: USA: Griffon sees $5.5 mln loss on unit sales.
newsitem.headline: Griffon sees $5.5 mln loss on unit sales.

text.p: Griffon Corp said on Wednesday it had provided for an anticipated $5.5 million loss for the sale of its synthetic batting business and specialty hardware businesses.

The company, which announced the sale of its batting business and the decision to sell its hardware business, said the units had annual sales in the range of $40 million and operated at about a break-even level.

"The decision to exit these peripheral businesses eliminates operations that do not fit into Griffon's long-term growth plans and underscores the company's focus on its core operations," the company said.

Proceeds from the sale, estimated at $8 million, would be used to buy shares under Griffon's repurchase program, it said. The company, which makes and markets garage doors, develops laminated specialty plastic films and manufactures information and communication systems, was not immediately available to comment further.
